Class JVMud

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.engine.JVMud
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class JVMud extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Application entry point and supervisor. Owns public endpoints, administrator identities and worker lifecycles. LPC execution belongs exclusively to sandboxed worker JVMs; the engine remains available with no mudlibs.
